calls.title: Handoff Review / Features Refresh
calls.summary: The team convened to enhance the user interface layout and table optimization by removing unnecessary elements such as prerequisites, rules, and stale columns for a cleaner design that improves scanning efficiency across large datasets. Discussions included truncating long text labels in the name column while considering tooltips for key information retention, and exploring adjustable column widths to accommodate varying content lengths. Teresa Yung raised concerns about customizable column visibility affecting team workflows, while the consensus favored sticky headers for better navigation on laptops. The team also refined column content, renaming the version column to changes column to indicate pending approvals, and debated the relevance of the default value column. Future enhancements were discussed, focusing on linking to developer tools for improved feature discoverability and maintaining consistency in team-wide views.
calls.keywords: Feature Table, Column Truncation, Approval Flow, Sticky Header, Data Type, UI Refresh

calls.title: Handoff Review / Features Refresh
calls.summary: The team convened to discuss a comprehensive refresh of the feature table layout, emphasizing the removal of less useful columns like prerequisites and actions to enhance clarity and reduce clutter. They confirmed the ‘stale’ column's removal, despite some concerns, with plans for future improvements tied to usage analytics. The ‘changes’ column will replace the old ‘version’ column to better indicate edits needing review. Toggles for environments will move to the actions menu to prevent accidental changes, while tooltips will be implemented for truncated content. The discussion also included ensuring access to design files and a preference for filtering results over adjustable page sizes to improve user experience and maintain design consistency across the board.
calls.keywords: Feature Refresh, UI Layout, Column Truncation, Approval Flows, Sticky Headers, Environment Toggles
